title: Respiratory Assist Devices
cms_cov_policy: <p>CMS Pub. 100-03, Medicare National Coverage Determinations Manual, Chapter 1, Part 4, Section 240.9</p>
issue: <p>The LCD is revised to align with National Coverage Determination (NCD) 240.9 - Noninvasive Positive Pressure Ventilation (NIPPV) in the Home for the Treatment of Chronic Respiratory Failure (CRF) Consequent to Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD), which became effective 06/09/2025.</p>
